intro: Hibachi dinners are cooked at your table. Sushi is made to order at the bar.
notes: Consuming raw or undercooked meats, poultry, seafood, shellfish or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness, especially if you have certain medical conditions.
Please tell your server about any allergies before you order. Our kitchen handles shellfish, fish, soy, sesame, wheat, eggs and peanuts.
This is a sample menu for a fictional restaurant. Items and prices are illustrative.
